name: movie_sirius_b_lpqi_orm
label: Movie: Sirius B's diameter in one night on the five-telescope LPQI network with the final instrument (R = 10 000 spectrograph, 10 ps array)
notes: Sirius B (V 8.44, 28.5 uas) above 30 deg from La Palma for 5.4 h a night: every one of the ten NOT/TNG/GTC/WHT/INT pairs disperses it over 8650 channels at 10 ps; |V|^2 runs from 0.99 at 400 m to 0.5 at 1.5 km, and the diameter is fitted from all pairs and channels block by block.

glare_fraction 0.3: Sirius A (V -1.46 at 10 arcsec) is resolved out beyond 20 m, so its scattered light only adds to the accidentals; 0.3 of Sirius B's own rate is a working estimate for a 1 arcsec field stop at La Palma seeing (the aureole at 10 arcsec; to be replaced by a measured value).

Panels: the ten uv tracks; |V|^2 against B/lambda with every pair's wavelength-binned points of the current block and the accumulated points binned in spatial frequency; the fitted diameter against time, the network against the NOT-TNG pair alone, with the HST radius x parallax value of Bond et al. 2017.
